SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT WHERE RQDT.BUYER = 'KRKEPB0004' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO LIKE 'A%' AND RQDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND TRIM(RQDT.ATOB_DATE) IS NOT NULL AND RQDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE > 0 AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PLANT, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO, ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, QTA_RESULT AS REMARK FROM ( SELECT RQDT.PLANT AS PLANT , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION AS REVISION_NO , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , RQDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , (SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(UNIT_PRICE, '^'),2)) FROM ( SELECT QT.BUYER, QT.QUOTATION_NO, QT.QUOTATION_SEQ, QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY QT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG DESC,QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE) RK FROM KEPQTDT QT INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY CP ON (1 = 1 AND CP.COM_CODE = QT.AGENT ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND NVL(QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0) > 0 AND QT.STATUS = 'C' ORDER BY QT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG DESC, QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE ) Z START WITH Z.RK = 1 CONNECT BY PRIOR Z.RK = ( Z.RK -1 ) ) AS QTA_RESULT , SUBSTRB(RQDT.ATOB_REMARK,1,100) AS ZCOMMENT FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' )
UPDATE KEPRQDT RQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
